abilities.name: Strike
abilities.description: A heavy swing at an adjacent foe. Your weapon adds to it.

abilities.name: Aimed Shot
abilities.description: Steady the revolver and fire. Needs the revolver; spends one round.

abilities.name: Ember Bolt
abilities.description: Hurl a gout of living slag. Burns an Ember Shard and ignores armor.

abilities.name: Mend
abilities.description: Doc Hollis's field dressing. Restores 8 HP to yourself.
